rv.q: Dear Evan Hansen is a show that holds you tight with its honesty of story told in a way that delights you to your very toes.
La Mirada's production, to put it in the simplest terms, is just absolutely outstanding all around—from its vocal and acting performances to its modern production design...
Dear Evan Hansen at the La Mirada Theatre makes it well worth the wait.
This is, hands down, the finest production of Dear Evan Hansen I’ve seen.
Each song is fulfilling and masterly woven into the narrative of this amazing musical: making for a stellar cast album.

cn.t: Critics widely praise Dear Evan Hansen as emotionally powerful, with its near-perfect score and a breakout lead performance earning strong acclaim across the board.
